fields.desc: **Abjuration** spells are protective in nature, though some of them have aggressive uses. They create magical barriers, negate harmful effects, harm trespassers, or banish creatures to other planes of existence.
fields.name: Abjuration

fields.desc: **Divination** spells reveal information, whether in the form of secrets long forgotten, glimpses of the future, the locations of hidden things, the truth behind illusions, or visions of distant people or places.
fields.name: Divination

fields.desc: **Evocation** spells manipulate magical energy to produce a desired effect. Some call up blasts of fire or lightning. Others channel positive energy to heal wounds.
fields.name: Evocation

fields.desc: **Illusion** spells deceive the senses or minds of others. They cause people to see things that are not there, to miss things that are there, to hear phantom noises, or to remember things that never happened. Some illusions create phantom images that any creature can see, but the most insidious illusions plant an image directly in the mind of a creature.
fields.name: Illusion
疗伤术
fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Cure Wounds。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

接触一名生物，恢复 2d8 加施法属性调整值的生命值；升环变化保留在 higher_level 和原施法变体中。

原规则适用职业：Bard、Cleric、Druid、Paladin、Ranger。适用范围保留原规则含义。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
fields.higher_level: The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

fields.name: 探灵术
fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Detect Magic。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

维持专注，在持续时间内感知自身周围 30 英尺内的魔法效果；查看灵光需要执行原规则的 Magic action，且受原文所列材料阻隔。

原规则适用职业：Bard、Cleric、Druid、Paladin、Ranger、Sorcerer、Warlock、Wizard。适用范围保留原规则含义。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

fields.name: 火弹术
fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Fire Bolt。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

向射程内的生物或物体投出火焰，进行远程法术攻击；命中造成 1d10 火焰伤害。未被穿戴或携带的可燃物体被命中时起火。

原规则适用职业：Sorcerer、Wizard。适用范围保留原规则含义。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
fields.higher_level: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

fields.name: 隐身术
fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Invisibility。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

接触目标，使其获得原 Invisible 状态；目标进行攻击检定、造成伤害或施放法术后，效果立即提前结束。此法术仍需维持专注。

原规则适用职业：Bard、Sorcerer、Warlock、Wizard。适用范围保留原规则含义。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
fields.higher_level: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Potion of Healing。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

中文名暂用“疗伤丹”，原物品实际为魔法药水，剂型未作规则改编。以一个附赠动作饮用或给自身 5 英尺内的另一生物服用，饮用者恢复 2d4 + 2 生命值。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.
fields.name: 疗伤丹

fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Wand of Magic Detection。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

此杖有 3 次充能；持有时可消耗 1 次充能施放 Detect Magic（本批中文名“探灵术”）；每日黎明恢复 1d3 次已消耗充能。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Detect Magic from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
fields.name: 探灵杖

fields.desc:
> 中文试录，沿用 SRD 原规则，非完成修仙规则改编。原名：Invisible。中文仅作导读，英文正文完整保留，尚未全文翻译。

以下保留原 Invisible 状态的完整说明；优势、劣势等术语继续采用原规则。

### 原英文正文（完整保留）

While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects. 
* Surprise. If you’re Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll. 
* Concealed. You aren’t affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen unless the effect’s creator can somehow see you. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is also concealed.
*Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don’t gain this benefit against that creature.
Flames, unbearable heat
Toxic gas, venom
Mind-rending energy
